purpose: Source register for improving spatial accuracy, building interiors and interpretation. Listing a source here does not mean that its contents have already been incorporated into the public model.

currentModel.walkableInferredBuildingCaveat: Study interiors based on source-model footprints and storeys. Stair positions, partitions, furniture and colours are inferred, not measured or photographically verified. Count spans all model eras, not simultaneous existence.

evidenceLabels.measured: Dimensions or positions taken from a drawing or survey with a stated scale.
evidenceLabels.documented: Form or use supported by contemporary photographs, reports or plans but not fully dimensioned.
evidenceLabels.inferred: A clearly labelled reconstruction used only where direct evidence is absent.

walkUpdate.terrainCorrection: Walk-only inferred DEM cut beneath existing building footprints, with cell-diagonal clearance and a short outer blend; not a newly surveyed landform.
walkUpdate.jigokudanWalk: The documented Jigokudan stair exists in the source scene. The walking copy keeps its 46 authored horizontal positions and dimensions but evenly interpolates tread heights so it can be traversed; position, count and gradient remain explicitly inferred rather than measured.
